claims.speaker: Brooke Turk
claims.sentence: Starting with revenue, third-quarter revenue was $35.3 million, up approximately 9% from $32.4 million in the second quarter.

claims.speaker: Brooke Turk
claims.sentence: This resulted in net income for the third quarter of $26.6 million, compared to a net loss of $2.5 million in the second quarter.

claims.speaker: Jeremy Schneiderman
claims.sentence: We have repositioned the company to focus on our core business, and we grew quarterly revenue sequentially again to $35.3 million, while taking corporate and development spending down sharply and continuing to work through the balance sheet and liquidity matters with our creditors and warrant holders.
